definitions.gloss: to admire, to appreciate, to take pleasure in the beauty of
definitions.explanation: To appreciate or take pleasure in the beauty of nature, art, or other aesthetically pleasing things. A somewhat literary or elevated word that conveys mindful, unhurried appreciation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|め}で⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: We drank sake while admiring the moon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{咲|さ}いた→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|め}でる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつだ。
examples.english: Admiring the autumn leaves blooming in the garden is one of the joys of fall.

notes:
{愛|め}でる is a literary and refined verb for appreciating beauty, especially in nature.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|め}でる

ASPECT (ている):
{愛|め}でて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing act of appreciating beauty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|め}でる: to admire flowers
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|め}でる: to admire the moon
- ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|め}でる: to admire autumn leaves
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|め}でる: to admire cherry blossoms

RELATED WORDS:
The word {愛|め}でたい (auspicious, happy) is derived from the same root. The noun form {愛|め}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (appreciation, admiration) exists but is rare in modern usage.

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and elevated. In everyday speech, ⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to appreciate) or ⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy) are more common, but {愛|め}でる carries a distinctly Japanese aesthetic sensibility.
